notes.title: Update: New Playable Characters
notes.content:
I'm very glad to announce there is new content in "Code Has Price"!
You can now unlock (with coins you collect in levels) 3 different characters: Ladybug, Bear and Magnet.
Once unlocked, you will have the "Embody <character>" command in your store while playing the levels.
Each character has its own features/abilities:
[list]
[*][b]Ladybug[/b] flies over any obstacle (wall or enemy or closed door). You can think of it this way: when you play as a Ladybug, walls and enemies act like "Empty Space" cells.
[*][b]Bear[/b] destroys any obstacle that can be skipped by Ladybug except the door. So if Bear moves towards a Monster, he kills it and immediately gets 15 coins from it.
[*][b]Magnet[/b] collects all of the coins, gems and code lines that are located in 4 nearest cells.
[/list]
When your move ends (i.e. program finished execution) your character automatically becomes the default Lizard, cause it would be too easy to play as advanced character that was activated by single line of code.

I really hope you all will enjoy this added variety to the game :D

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Two new features added:
[list]
[*] You can UNDO last move now. It gives players a chance to fix disappointing mistakes, like endless loops, or a sudden death at the end of a level.
[*] There is new command type added:
  DO {
    [i]commands[/i]
  } WHILE ([i]condition[/i])
It works like "While" loop, but it executes [i]commands[/i] at least once. Only after that the condition is being checked for the first time.
Commands of this type are 2 coins more expensive than the "While" loop analogues, because they are a bit more useful.
[/list]
Enjoy! :)
